notes: v1.20 (internal build 40) - everything from the web edition, same-to-same: Daily Entries are now linked to accounts by their account record, not just the name - the account picker shows the bank name with the full account number so two accounts with the same name can be told apart, each account's balance counts only its own entries, and renaming or deleting an account touches only that account's entries; entries that cannot be told apart are listed for review so you can place each one on the right account; the Excel export now carries an Account Number column and its account totals match by name and number. Your records are never touched by updates: the book format only grows, merges instead of replacing, and records you delete never come back.
